request.system:
You are the verifier judge in Ledger. You check whether each clause of an extracted COBOL business rule is supported by the source lines it cites.

For each clause you get its text and the cited lines (marked with >>), with a few surrounding lines for context only. A clause is supported when the cited lines, read with ordinary COBOL semantics, establish what the clause says. Mark it unsupported if it states something the cited lines do not show, gets a condition, comparison, sign, code or message wrong, or relies mainly on lines outside the cited span. Be strict about meaning, not about wording. Give a one-sentence reason either way.

messages.content:
Rule BR-CBTRN02C-003: Reject transaction that would exceed the account credit limit

### given[0]: The account record was found.
fields=['ACCOUNT-RECORD'] literals=[]
CBTRN02C.cbl:
   391            END-READ
   392            EXIT.
   393        1500-B-LOOKUP-ACCT.
   394            MOVE XREF-ACCT-ID TO FD-ACCT-ID
>> 395            READ ACCOUNT-FILE INTO ACCOUNT-RECORD
>> 396               INVALID KEY
>> 397                 MOVE 101 TO WS-VALIDATION-FAIL-REASON
>> 398                 MOVE 'ACCOUNT RECORD NOT FOUND'
>> 399                   TO WS-VALIDATION-FAIL-REASON-DESC
>> 400               NOT INVALID KEY
   401       *         DISPLAY 'ACCT-CREDIT-LIMIT:' ACCT-CREDIT-LIMIT
   402       *         DISPLAY 'TRAN-AMT         :' DALYTRAN-AMT
   403                 COMPUTE WS-TEMP-BAL = ACCT-CURR-CYC-CREDIT
   404                                     - ACCT-CURR-CYC-DEBIT

### given[1]: The projected balance is current-cycle credits minus current-cycle debits plus the transaction amount. Since ROUNDED is not written, the result is truncated, not rounded.
fields=['WS-TEMP-BAL', 'ACCT-CURR-CYC-CREDIT', 'ACCT-CURR-CYC-DEBIT', 'DALYTRAN-AMT'] literals=[]
CBTRN02C.cbl:
   399                   TO WS-VALIDATION-FAIL-REASON-DESC
   400               NOT INVALID KEY
   401       *         DISPLAY 'ACCT-CREDIT-LIMIT:' ACCT-CREDIT-LIMIT
   402       *         DISPLAY 'TRAN-AMT         :' DALYTRAN-AMT
>> 403                 COMPUTE WS-TEMP-BAL = ACCT-CURR-CYC-CREDIT
>> 404                                     - ACCT-CURR-CYC-DEBIT
>> 405                                     + DALYTRAN-AMT
   406 
   407                 IF ACCT-CREDIT-LIMIT >= WS-TEMP-BAL
   408                   CONTINUE
   409                 ELSE

### given[2]: The projected balance field holds 9 integer digits and 2 decimals (signed). Any result of 1,000,000,000.00 or more in magnitude loses its high-order digit before the comparison.
fields=['WS-TEMP-BAL'] literals=[]
CBTRN02C.cbl:
   183 
   184         01 WS-COUNTERS.
   185            05 WS-TRANSACTION-COUNT          PIC 9(09) VALUE 0.
   186            05 WS-REJECT-COUNT               PIC 9(09) VALUE 0.
>> 187            05 WS-TEMP-BAL                   PIC S9(09)V99.
   188 
   189         01 WS-FLAGS.
   190            05 WS-CREATE-TRANCAT-REC         PIC X(01) VALUE 'N'.
   191 

### given[3]: The account's current-cycle credit and debit amounts each hold 10 integer digits and 2 decimals (signed), so they can hold values that the projected balance field cannot.
fields=['ACCT-CURR-CYC-CREDIT', 'ACCT-CURR-CYC-DEBIT'] literals=[]
CVACT01Y.cpy:
     9            05  ACCT-CASH-CREDIT-LIMIT            PIC S9(10)V99.
    10            05  ACCT-OPEN-DATE                    PIC X(10).
    11            05  ACCT-EXPIRAION-DATE               PIC X(10).
    12            05  ACCT-REISSUE-DATE                 PIC X(10).
>>  13            05  ACCT-CURR-CYC-CREDIT              PIC S9(10)V99.
>>  14            05  ACCT-CURR-CYC-DEBIT               PIC S9(10)V99.
    15            05  ACCT-ADDR-ZIP                     PIC X(10).
    16            05  ACCT-GROUP-ID                     PIC X(10).
    17            05  FILLER                            PIC X(178).
    18       *

### when[0]: The account credit limit is less than the projected balance. A credit limit equal to the balance passes.
fields=['ACCT-CREDIT-LIMIT', 'WS-TEMP-BAL'] literals=[]
CBTRN02C.cbl:
   403                 COMPUTE WS-TEMP-BAL = ACCT-CURR-CYC-CREDIT
   404                                     - ACCT-CURR-CYC-DEBIT
   405                                     + DALYTRAN-AMT
   406 
>> 407                 IF ACCT-CREDIT-LIMIT >= WS-TEMP-BAL
>> 408                   CONTINUE
>> 409                 ELSE
>> 410                   MOVE 102 TO WS-VALIDATION-FAIL-REASON
>> 411                   MOVE 'OVERLIMIT TRANSACTION'
>> 412                     TO WS-VALIDATION-FAIL-REASON-DESC
>> 413                 END-IF
   414                 IF ACCT-EXPIRAION-DATE >= DALYTRAN-ORIG-TS (1:10)
   415                   CONTINUE
   416                 ELSE
   417                   MOVE 103 TO WS-VALIDATION-FAIL-REASON

### then[0]: The failure reason code is set to 102 and the failure description to 'OVERLIMIT TRANSACTION'. The expiration-date check still runs afterwards and, if it fails, overwrites the reason with 103.
fields=['WS-VALIDATION-FAIL-REASON', 'WS-VALIDATION-FAIL-REASON-DESC', 'ACCT-EXPIRAION-DATE'] literals=['102', 'OVERLIMIT TRANSACTION', '103']
CBTRN02C.cbl:
   406 
   407                 IF ACCT-CREDIT-LIMIT >= WS-TEMP-BAL
   408                   CONTINUE
   409                 ELSE
>> 410                   MOVE 102 TO WS-VALIDATION-FAIL-REASON
>> 411                   MOVE 'OVERLIMIT TRANSACTION'
>> 412                     TO WS-VALIDATION-FAIL-REASON-DESC
>> 413                 END-IF
>> 414                 IF ACCT-EXPIRAION-DATE >= DALYTRAN-ORIG-TS (1:10)
>> 415                   CONTINUE
>> 416                 ELSE
>> 417                   MOVE 103 TO WS-VALIDATION-FAIL-REASON
>> 418                   MOVE 'TRANSACTION RECEIVED AFTER ACCT EXPIRATION'
>> 419                     TO WS-VALIDATION-FAIL-REASON-DESC
>> 420                 END-IF
   421            END-READ
   422            EXIT.
   423       *---------------------------------------------------------------*
   424        2000-POST-TRANSACTION.

### then[1]: Unless the expiration check later overwrites the reason, the transaction is rejected with reason 102. The reject count goes up by 1 and a reject record is written instead of posting.
fields=['WS-VALIDATION-FAIL-REASON', 'WS-REJECT-COUNT'] literals=['0', '1']
CBTRN02C.cbl:
   207       *              DISPLAY DALYTRAN-RECORD
   208                      MOVE 0 TO WS-VALIDATION-FAIL-REASON
   209                      MOVE SPACES TO WS-VALIDATION-FAIL-REASON-DESC
   210                      PERFORM 1500-VALIDATE-TRAN
>> 211                      IF WS-VALIDATION-FAIL-REASON = 0
>> 212                        PERFORM 2000-POST-TRANSACTION
>> 213                      ELSE
>> 214                        ADD 1 TO WS-REJECT-COUNT
>> 215                        PERFORM 2500-WRITE-REJECT-REC
>> 216                      END-IF
   217                    END-IF
   218                END-IF
   219            END-PERFORM.
   220

clause.description: clause id as given, e.g. when[0]

content.text: {"verdicts":[{"clause":"given[0]","supported":true,"reason":"Lines 395-400 show the READ of ACCOUNT-FILE with INVALID KEY and NOT INVALID KEY branches, and the found case is the NOT INVALID KEY branch."},{"clause":"given[1]","supported":true,"reason":"Lines 403-405 compute WS-TEMP-BAL as ACCT-CURR-CYC-CREDIT minus ACCT-CURR-CYC-DEBIT plus DALYTRAN-AMT, and since ROUNDED is not specified the result is truncated."},{"clause":"given[2]","supported":true,"reason":"Line 187 defines WS-TEMP-BAL as PIC S9(09)V99, so a COMPUTE without ON SIZE ERROR loses high-order digits on values of 1,000,000,000.00 or more in magnitude."},{"clause":"given[3]","supported":true,"reason":"Lines 13-14 define ACCT-CURR-CYC-CREDIT and ACCT-CURR-CYC-DEBIT as PIC S9(10)V99, which is one integer digit wider than WS-TEMP-BAL."},{"clause":"when[0]","supported":true,"reason":"Line 407 continues when ACCT-CREDIT-LIMIT >= WS-TEMP-BAL, so the ELSE branch runs only when the limit is less than the balance, and an equal value passes."},{"clause":"then[0]","supported":true,"reason":"Lines 410-412 set reason 102 and 'OVERLIMIT TRANSACTION', and lines 414-420 then run the expiration check unconditionally, which may overwrite the reason with 103."},{"clause":"then[1]","supported":true,"reason":"Lines 211-216 post only when WS-VALIDATION-FAIL-REASON = 0; otherwise they add 1 to WS-REJECT-COUNT and perform 2500-WRITE-REJECT-REC."}]}
